description: Norms for /release-notes — six fixed JQL queries per fixVersion (Corner PMOPROC split: Master, FX Spot, Retail Banking). No corner-map.

jql.order_by: ORDER BY priority DESC, key ASC

templates.fx_spot_base: project = {project_xt} AND fixVersion = {version} AND "dxProject Key" in ({pmoproc_fx_spot}) AND "Epic Link" not in ({epic_fx_spot_exclude}) AND status not in ({status_exclude_fx_base}) {order_by}
templates.master_base: project = {project_xt} AND fixVersion = {version} AND ("dxProject Key" in ({pmoproc_master}) OR "Epic Link" in ({epic_master_include})) AND status not in ({status_exclude_master_base}) {order_by}
templates.retail_banking_base: project = {project_xt} AND fixVersion = {version} AND "dxProject Key" in ({pmoproc_retail_banking}) AND status not in ({status_exclude_retail_banking_base}) {order_by}
templates.fx_spot_adaptive: fixVersion = "{adaptive_fixversion}" AND ("dxProject Key" in ({pmoproc_fx_spot}) AND "Epic Link" not in ({epic_fx_spot_exclude})) AND status not in ({status_exclude_adaptive}) {order_by}
templates.master_adaptive: fixVersion = "{adaptive_fixversion}" AND ("dxProject Key" in ({pmoproc_master}) OR "Epic Link" in ({epic_master_include})) AND status not in ({status_exclude_adaptive}) {order_by}
templates.retail_banking_adaptive: fixVersion = "{adaptive_fixversion}" AND "dxProject Key" in ({pmoproc_retail_banking}) AND status not in ({status_exclude_adaptive}) {order_by}
